modules.name: Engine
modules.blurb: A deterministic ephemeris and calculation core — Swiss-Ephemeris-grade charts, transits, and timing, licensed rather than reinvented so we build where it matters.

modules.name: Corpus
modules.blurb: Interpretation grounded in named traditions and lineages — Hellenistic, Vedic, esoteric tarot — cited, versioned, and auditable. No hallucinated cosmology.

modules.name: Synthesis
modules.blurb: The genuinely novel layer: cross-system readings that weave natal astrology, tarot spreads, and numerology into one coherent narrative arc.

modules.name: Voice
modules.blurb: A private model trained on your readings, your phrasing, your ethics. It drafts in your voice; you refine and sign. You own it, and it leaves with you.

modules.name: Attest
modules.blurb: Cryptographic, C2PA-style provenance on every reading: read by a verified human, disclosed where AI assisted, timestamped and tamper-evident.

modules.name: Memory
modules.blurb: Longitudinal seeker memory — consented, portable context that lets a returning client be met as a person, not a fresh intake form.

modules.name: Guardrails
modules.blurb: Refusals for health, death, pregnancy, and specific financial predictions; AI-disclosure by default; self-harm protocols. Built for SB 243, NY §1700, and the EU AI Act.

modules.name: Commerce
modules.blurb: Storefronts, booking, and high-risk-ready payment rails under merchant-of-record discipline — the pain we solve first, because it's the one that kills practices.

modules.name: Discover
modules.blurb: From 2029: a seeker-facing discovery layer across the network — attested practitioners, honest claims, a 10–20% take that funds the commons.

pains.name: The account that vanishes
pains.blurb: Stripe lists psychic services among restricted businesses. Practitioners lose processing overnight for using the word “tarot” on a checkout page — with the quarter's income in limbo.

pains.name: The app that never ships
pains.blurb: Apple's Guideline 4.3 groups fortune-telling with spam. Struck was rejected roughly ten times. A practitioner alone has no leverage and no appeal.

pains.name: The AI that undercuts
pains.blurb: Generic AI readings are free and infinite. Translation lost a third of its work to the machine; stock photography collapsed. Interpretation-as-commodity is next.

pains.name: The stack held with tape
pains.blurb: Calendly for booking, Wix for the site, Patreon for members, Instagram for reach — five logins, zero of them built for sacred work, none of them defending you.
